anyOf.description: A finite value, written as a JSON number.
A non-finite value, written as its sentinel string.

NonFiniteF64Wire.description:
An `f64` in the [`non_finite_f64`] wire form: a JSON number when finite,
otherwise one of the strings `"inf"`, `"-inf"` or `"nan"`.

Contract types store plain `f64` fields with
`#[serde(with = "finstack_quant_core::wire::non_finite_f64")]` and name this
type in `#[schemars(with = ...)]`, so the generated schema describes the
sentinel strings the serializer actually writes.

NonFiniteSentinel.description: Sentinel string the [`non_finite_f64`] adapter writes for a non-finite `f64`.

oneOf.description: Found feasible solution but solver stopped early.

conflicting_constraints.description: Constraints that appear to conflict (if determinable).

message.description: Error message describing what went wrong.

PositiveF64Wire.description:
Finite JSON number that is strictly greater than zero.

This type is used by serde field adapters so runtime deserialization and
generated schemas enforce the same positive-number contract.

fx_policy_applied.description: Optional FX policy applied by the computing layer (human-readable key).

numeric_mode.description:
Numeric engine mode used to produce the results.

Always [`NUMERIC_MODE_F64`] today; a plain string so result
envelopes stay wire-compatible across host languages.

parallel.description:
Whether the producing computation ran in parallel.

Serial results omit the field entirely so existing payloads and golden
files stay byte-identical.

rounding.description: Rounding context snapshot applied to IO boundaries.

timestamp.description:
Timestamp when result was computed (ISO 8601 format).
Useful for audit trails and reproducibility.

version.description: Finstack Quant library version used to produce the result.

RoundingContext.description:
Snapshot of active rounding settings used for result stamping.

Instances are typically produced via [`rounding_context_from`] and persisted
alongside valuation results.

ingest_scale_by_currency.description: Validated ingest scale snapshot by currency code, with values in `0..=28`.

output_scale_by_currency.description: Validated output scale snapshot by currency code, with values in `0..=28`.

tolerances.description: Tolerance settings snapshot for floating-point comparisons.

SchemaVersion.description: Numeric schema revision for contracts whose sole supported revision is v1.

generic_epsilon.description:
Epsilon for generic floating-point comparisons (default: 1e-10).

Used for general numerical comparisons where higher tolerance is acceptable.

rate_epsilon.description:
Epsilon for rate comparisons (default: 1e-12).

Used when comparing interest rates, yields, and other small ratios.

oneOf.description: Increase the signed instrument quantity, including covering a short.
Decrease the signed instrument quantity, including increasing a short.

TradeSpec.description: Trade specification for a single position.

direction.description: Buy / Sell / Hold classification from the sign of `delta_quantity`.

position_id.description: Position identifier in the optimized portfolio.

TradeType.description: Whether a trade is for an existing position or a new candidate.

oneOf.description: Adding a new position from the candidate universe.
Closing out an existing position entirely.

description: Canonical typed v1 output from portfolio optimization.

constraint_slacks.description: Constraint slack values; undefined averages use the `"nan"` sentinel.

implied_quantities.description: Implied target quantities keyed by position.

is_feasible.description: Whether the solution can be consumed.

meta.description: Configuration and numerical provenance from the solve.

objective_value.description:
Objective value at the solution.

`NaN` when the solve is not feasible; non-finite values travel as the
string sentinels `"nan"`, `"inf"` and `"-inf"` so the result round-trips.

turnover.description:
Gross turnover.

`NaN` when the solve is not feasible; encoded like `objective_value`.
